title: Flare day brewing?
caption: Flare day brewing? Today feels a bit wobbly, with energy and symptoms that can swing when you push. Break jobs into small pieces with pauses, and keep meals and water steady to pace the day.
snapshot: Conditions are unsettled rather than quiet today. Solar wind is around typical levels, and the magnetic field favored a southward tilt at times. A small solar flare was recorded. Multiple CMEs were seen but without evidence of an Earth aim.
affects: Primary pattern: chronic-illness flare risk may feel closer to the surface. You may notice faster fatigue when you push, and symptoms can swing a bit through the day. Sensory load and rushing may turn up discomfort.
playbook:
- Break tasks into smaller pieces with pauses
- Keep meals and hydration steady
- Trim nonessential errands or screens
- Use a short rest or breath break before symptoms spike
